mechanism_narrative: Increasing GDP indicates strong economic activity, leading to higher S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Forward returns do not correlate positively with GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: Declining unemployment signals economic strength, boosting S&P 500.
failure_condition: Returns do not increase when unemployment drops below 5%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production and employment indicate economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: No positive returns when both series increase.

mechanism_narrative: Higher federal funds rate in tightening cycles negatively impacts S&P 500.
failure_condition: Returns do not drop when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4%.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing housing starts reflect economic growth, leading to higher S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: No correlation between housing starts and returns.

mechanism_narrative: CPI increase above 270 may lead to inflation, negatively impacting S&P 500.
failure_condition: Returns do not drop when CPI exceeds 270.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales and employment indicate strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: No positive returns when both series increase.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth in late-cycle expansion boosts S&P 500.
failure_condition: Returns do not rise with industrial production growth.
